newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs steady to up in quiet activity.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs steady to up in quiet activity.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were steady to stronger in quiet trade on Monday as players stood on the sidelines looking for direction in NYMEX futures, players said.
"Buyers are waiting for crude to come down more but sellers are hoping it will go back up," said a Houston trader.
NYMEX crude oil futures made a sharp retracement from Friday's rally, closing down 53 cents at $21.59 a barrel.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane remained between 35.75 cents and 36.00 cents a gallon. Conway, Kansas, material was notional.
Belvieu normal butane, which has seen some recent activity, gained a quarter cent to 42.25/42.50 cents. Conway material was steady from Friday.
Belvieu purity ethane was up a quarter, putting sellers at 21.50 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk, 1 212 859 1631
